role: MainActor @Observable singleton that fetches current conditions from MET Norway Locationforecast 2.0 compact (rate-limited, cached against Expires, If-Modified-Since for same place) and exposes a WeatherSnapshot to the workout coach and archived workouts; plus MetNorwayForecast, the response parser and symbol→condition mapping, and the condition-name localisation table.
types: WeatherService: class (@Observable @MainActor) — fetch/caching of current weather, singleton .shared
MetNorwayForecast: struct (Equatable) — parsed hourly steps + Last-Modified + Expires; snapshot(at:)
MetNorwayForecast.Hour: struct — one step's temperature, humidity, wind, symbol
MetNorwayForecast.Response (+Properties/Step/StepData/Instant/Details/Period/Summary): private Decodable structs mirroring MET JSON
state: mem:MetNorwayForecast.symbolConditions (static symbol base → English condition table)
toplevel: Header (6-22) states MET Norway terms compliance: User-Agent, 2-decimal coordinates, no repeat before Expires nor within 10 minutes, If-Modified-Since. userAgent static initializer reads Bundle.main.appVersion. Response Decodable conformance synthesized; decoder uses .iso8601 dates.

flags.text: The request-gating and cache logic (refreshIfNeeded, cacheCovers, apply, isSamePlace) has no test; MetNorwayForecastTests only checks parsing, snapshot, symbols, the Expires parser, userAgent and the minimumRequestInterval constant.

units.does: Returns the stored snapshot only while fetchedAt is less than 3 h old; otherwise nil.

branches.cond: fetchedAt set and younger than maxSnapshotAge (3 h)

flags.text: current is time-dependent but only snapshot/fetchedAt are observed, so an observing SwiftUI view does not refresh when the snapshot ages out; callers WorkoutRecorder+Context.swift:77/314 and WorkoutRecorder+Lifecycle.swift:649 read it imperatively, so the effect is limited to any future view binding.

units.does: Applies a fetch outcome: fresh replaces forecast, notModified updates forecast.expires, failed changes nothing; then snapshots the forecast at now and, if non-nil, stores snapshot, fetchedAt=now and fetchedAtCoord.

flags.text: fetch/outcome are static members of the @MainActor class, so after the URLSession await the JSON decode (MetNorwayForecast.parse) runs on the main actor. This contradicts the header's 'Fetches never block the main thread' and ARCHITECTURE.md's 'Fetched off-main'.
